title: The mystery of Spanish accent marks
summary: Practise the basic Spanish accent rules for agudas, llanas and esdrújulas in these exercises.
keyIdeas: Agudas have stress on the last syllable. They take an accent mark when they end in a vowel, -n or -s.
Llanas have stress on the second-last syllable. They take an accent mark when they do not end in a vowel, -n or -s.
Esdrújulas have stress on the third-last syllable and always take an accent mark.

basicKnowledge: D. Reflexión sobre la lengua y sus usos en el marco de propuestas de producción y comprensión de textos orales, escritos o multimodales

activities.prompt: What is a Spanish written accent mark, called a «tilde»?
activities.explanation: A Spanish accent mark is written over some vowels according to spelling rules.
activities.hint: Think of the short sloping mark written over some vowels.
options: Any capital letter at the beginning of a sentence.
The sloping mark above the vowel in the stressed syllable.
The full stop showing that a sentence has ended.

activities.prompt: Spanish words called «esdrújulas» always have an accent mark on their stressed syllable.
activities.explanation: Correct! Esdrújulas always have an accent mark, whatever their last letter.

activities.prompt: Match each Spanish word type to the position of its stressed syllable.
activities.explanation: Agudas have stress on the last syllable, llanas on the second-last and esdrújulas on the third-last.

activities.prompt: Choose the correctly spelt Spanish word to complete the sentence.
activities.explanation: «plátano» is an esdrújula. Like all esdrújulas, it has an accent mark on the third-last syllable.
activities.sentence: Omar fue a la frutería del barrio y compró un ___ muy dulce.

activities.prompt: Sort these Spanish words by their stressed syllable.
activities.explanation: «balón» and «compás» are agudas. «árbol» and «lápiz» are llanas with accent marks. «música» and «médico» are esdrújulas.

activities.prompt: Aisha prepares a list for a school trip. Which word is an «aguda» that needs an accent mark?
activities.explanation: «Colibrí» is an aguda ending in a vowel, so it needs an accent mark on the last syllable.
activities.hint: Agudas take accent marks when they end in a vowel, -n or -s.

activities.prompt: The library notice says «Por favor, mantén silencio en el salon». Which word has a mistake?
activities.explanation: «salón» is an aguda ending in n, so it needs an accent mark.
activities.hint: Find an aguda ending in -n with a missing accent mark.

activities.prompt: Put the steps in order to decide whether a Spanish word needs an accent mark.
activities.explanation: First split it into syllables, find the stressed syllable, identify the word type and apply the spelling rule.
items: Decide whether it is aguda, llana or esdrújula.
Check the rule for adding an accent mark.

activities.prompt: Read the Spanish story about Mateo's invention and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Reading helps us discover the agudas, llanas and esdrújulas used in Spanish writing.
activities.title: El invento de Mateo
activities.text: Mateo ha construido un robot con cajas de cartón y tapones. En la feria de ciencias, su invento llamó mucho la atención. El robot tiene una bombilla roja en la cabeza y una pequeña hélice en la espalda. Cuando Mateo pulsa el botón amarillo, el robot da tres pasos firmes. Su amiga Nerea le ayudó a pintar un cartel explicativo. En el cartel escribieron las normas de uso para evitar que tocaran los cables. Mateo estaba muy feliz porque su invento funcionó genial y todos aplaudieron entusiasmados.

questions.prompt: Why do Mateo and Nerea write an explanatory sign?
questions.explanation: They write rules to stop people touching the robot's wires.
options: To sell cardboard boxes to their classmates.
To give rules for using the robot and protect its wires.
To borrow a red light bulb from the teacher.

questions.prompt: Why does «hélice» have an accent mark?
questions.explanation: «hé-li-ce» has stress on the third-last syllable. It is an esdrújula, so it always has an accent mark.
options: Because it is an esdrújula, which always takes an accent mark.
Because it is an aguda ending in a vowel.
Because it is a llana ending in a consonant other than -n or -s.

activities.prompt: Complete the Spanish sentence with the verb form for the time of the action.
activities.explanation: «marcó» describes a past action. It is an aguda ending in a vowel, so it has an accent mark on the last syllable.
activities.sentence: En el recreo de ayer, Hugo ___ un gol increíble desde el centro del patio.
